ModMetaData.name: If It Can Haul, It Can Pack
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Any animal that can be trained to haul can also carry cargo on a caravan.
In vanilla, caravan carrying capacity is controlled by a separate "pack animal" flag that has nothing to do with the Haul training. Plenty of big, smart, haul-capable animals (vanilla and modded) contribute 0 kg to a caravan because of it.
At game startup this mod checks every animal with the game's own "can this be trained to haul?" rule and marks the ones that pass as pack animals. Capacity is the vanilla formula (body size x 35 kg). Works with any animal mod and any load order.
Individual animals can be turned off in the mod settings (takes effect after a restart). Animals flagged by this mod show no saddlebags, since they have no pack artwork.
The check runs once while the game loads. Nothing runs during play.
